$comment: Documents the credentialed Next.js version (#1376): test-e2e-deploy.yml's and compat-vinext.yml's NEXTJS_REF (the Next.js ref every compat cell tests) versus packages/kn-next/templates/app/package.json.hbs's next pin (the Next.js version the scaffold actually ships). tests/nextjs-credential-lockstep.test.ts fails if either real value drifts from what THIS file documents, so a future bump to either side must update this manifest in the same PR — a reviewed decision, never silent drift.
divergenceReason: RESOLVED 2026-09-27 (#1376): the two values are now in lockstep. HISTORY, kept for context: Next 16.3.0 introduced a confirmed upstream regression (Turbopack + adapterPath + output:'standalone' -> ENOENT next-server.js.nft.json, vercel/next.js; see issue #1372), which broke every Turbopack-credentialed cell for 16.3.0 through 16.3.4 (16.2.x was never affected). Between #1379 (this manifest's introduction) and #1386 (the fix), the credentialed lane deliberately stayed at v16.2.0 while the scaffold shipped 16.3.3/16.3.5, so re-credentialing on a still-broken version would not zero out both turbopack-credentialed lanes. #1386 fixed #1372 upstream-side (bumped the scaffold to 16.3.5, narrowed the pre-build Turbopack guard to the confirmed 16.3.0-16.3.4 window, and verified with a live local repro that Turbopack + adapterPath + output:'standalone' builds clean on 16.3.5) but deliberately left the credential itself at v16.2.0, tracking the re-credentialing decision here. This PR makes that decision: bump credentialedNextRef to v16.3.5, matching the shipped pin. No v1.0 release-candidate tag has been cut yet (.github/compat-credential-ref.json's rcTag is null), so no scheduled credential night has measured this pin yet — the existing 788/0 evidence (docs/compat-matrix.md) remains attributed to v16.2.0, the version it was actually measured against.
